perf.metric: Startup, scenario runtime and bounded evidence validation

lanes.predicate: Regression lane against trunk. Lint the existing `.ts` fixtures at parent and head. Pass when head keeps every existing `.ts` rejection and trunk's absence of `.tsx` coverage is recorded honestly.
Add a `.tsx` fixture importing a storage type. Pass when lint rejects it with the same rule id `.ts` files already use.
Add a `.tsx` fixture calling a browser global outside the framework folder. Pass when lint rejects it and accepts the same call moved inside the framework folder.
Add a fixture using an unmediated effect outside the framework folder. Pass when lint rejects it and accepts the equivalent framework-owned hook.
Disable the `.tsx` glob in an isolated copy. Pass when the lane-2 assertion turns red, proving the guard is real.
Add an `eslint-disable` comment naming the new rule. Pass when the disable comment itself is rejected under the R25 exception contract.
Read the rejection message for each new rule. Pass when each names the supported owner and the sanctioned alternative path.
Run the widened lint against the paused renderer fixture branch content. Pass when its known drift is reproduced as rejections, not silently accepted.

Import one Feature from another without adding it to `dependencies.json`, and import a Feature from a framework-layer file. Pass when the undeclared Feature-to-Feature import is rejected naming the missing declaration, and the framework-layer import of a Feature is rejected naming Framework as the non-importing owner.
Run the full existing `.ts` boundary suite alongside the new `.tsx` suite. Pass when both pass together with no rule regression.

perf.metric: Lint wall time across the widened file set.
perf.rule: Equivalent behavior fails above 10% p95 regression. Fail lint wall time above twice the existing .ts-only baseline.

lanes.predicate: Regression lane against trunk. Generate the inventory from the current fixture Feature set at parent and head. Pass when head's generated inventory matches the fixture and trunk's absence of discovery is recorded honestly.
Add a Feature with both reserved files. Pass when it appears in the generated inventory with no manual registration.
Add a Feature missing its Entrypoint file. Pass when discovery fails naming the missing reserved file.
Place feature files outside the conventional `src/features/<name>/` path. Pass when the build rejects the location.
Hand-edit a generated inventory row. Pass when drift detection rejects the edit.
Disable drift detection in an isolated copy. Pass when the lane-5 assertion turns red.
Remove a Feature directory entirely. Pass when the generated inventory drops it and no stale reference remains.
Add two Features with the same declared name. Pass when discovery rejects the collision.
Read the rejection message for a misplaced or missing reserved file. Pass when it names the supported owner and the conventional path.
Regenerate the inventory twice with no source change. Pass when the second run is a no-op with an identical digest.

perf.rule: Equivalent behavior fails above 10% p95 regression. Fail generation above five seconds for the fixture Feature set.

lanes.predicate: Regression lane against trunk. Read and write fixture room state through the existing Client core at parent and head. Pass when head's named-hook surface reproduces the same replay/dedupe result trunk already proves.
Duplicate a durable value in component state. Pass when the build rejects the duplicate holder.
Call `fetch` or a WebSocket directly from a component. Pass when the build rejects it and accepts the same call through the Host.
Call `document` or `window` directly from a component. Pass when the build rejects it and accepts the same call through the Host.
Send a command through the Client and inspect the resulting receipt. Pass when the receipt matches R07's command-receipt shape.
Disable the one-writer guard in an isolated copy. Pass when the lane-2 assertion turns red.
Call a Host method with a malformed request. Pass when the typed interface rejects it at compile time, not at runtime.
Subscribe and unsubscribe through the Host repeatedly. Pass when no subscription leaks past its owning component's lifetime.
Read the rejection message for a bypassed Client or Host call. Pass when it names the supported hook, command, or Host method.
Run the existing Client core replay suite alongside the new named-hook suite. Pass when both pass together with no regression.
